hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.graphifyignore$'; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graphify extract . --force --code-only; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(py|ts|js|go|rs|java|php|cs)$'; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" graphify update .; fi || true
hooks.statusMessage: Atualizando Grafo de Conhecimento com Graphify...
